name: subq-snap-mcp
description: SubQ Snap decision model: answers fixed-choice questions about content with a probability per answer.
long_description: Adds one tool, decide, that sends a piece of content (state) and up to 128 named questions (yes/no, choice or score) to the SubQ Decisions API and returns a probability per answer instead of generated text. Used by the tech-llm-council plugin for routing, file relevance, strongest-response and agreement checks. The content you pass to the tool is sent to SubQ (api.subq.ai); you need your own SubQ API key.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Ask SubQ Snap yes/no, choice or score questions about content; returns a probability per answer.

api_key.title: SubQ API key
api_key.description: Your SubQ API key (from your SubQ account). Stored securely by the Claude desktop app.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for SubQ before the tool reports 'skipped'.
